name: Serena Marie Nevada Trumbo
notable_stories: Described as a master of shorthand and a June Cleaver figure who managed three children during her husband's global military deployments
Remarried Arthur Wells (San Francisco) after George Francis Adams' 1920 death
Moved in with John Howard Adams' family in San Francisco after Arthur Wells died (~1963-64), until her own death in 1967
After Arthur Wells died (when John was in 11th grade, ~1963-64), Nini came to live with John's family.
Nini died during John's second year at the Naval Academy (~1966-67), consistent with confirmed death date 28 Sep 1967.
John's father told him not to come home for the funeral.
She frequently wore white bobby socks around the house, saying it was 'what all the kids were wearing now-a-days.'
She would become very excited watching 'What's My Line' on television.
Had an aqua and white Hudson coupe that she and Arthur only drove when necessary.
Their apartment in downtown San Francisco had metropolitan traffic noise all night long.
Theirs was a 'yours, mine, and ours' family: Dad's siblings (Presley, Edith) from George Sr. + Nini, Rosemary Wells from Nini + Arthur, and another (Arthur's daughter from prior).
milestones: Married George Francis Adams (#2) (m. 7 Jan 1909, Lewis County, WA)
Following the 1920 death of George Francis Adams, she remarried Arthur Wells in 1929 and raised her children in San Francisco
Married George Francis Adams (#2) (7 January 1909, Lewis County, WA)
Married Arthur Wells (m. abt 1929, San Francisco, CA)
Parents: Presley Neville Trumbo (1840–1923) and Hannah Louise Buckley
Census 1920: Douglas County, Oregon, aged 30, born Washington
Census 1940: San Francisco, California, as Serena M. M. Wells, aged 50, wife of Arthur T. Wells
